rationale: `assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` has front matter, so it is a bundled skill and a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.next`. Its workflow checklist ends with step 9. That step ends with "Next: for gap-list items the user decides, follow the habeas-requirements skill." This names the bundled skill for the next task. The only other outcome is a run with no gap-list items to decide. That outcome leads to no further task, so the requirement needs no skill named for it. The later sections (Inventories, Report and so on) are reference material and not workflow steps. No violation matches were listed, so none needed judging.

text: Each bundled skill's workflow MUST end by naming the bundled skill for the next task, or, when different outcomes lead to different tasks, the skill for each such outcome.
